_comment: Design profile template (v0.3.10) — a named, reusable style bundle. Copy this into .vob-config/design-profiles/<name>.json (one file per profile; the directory is read once per process; files starting with '.' or '_' are skipped). A profile is applied to any project BY NAME, via `vob_init_project { design_profile: "<name>" }`, the VOB_DESIGN_PROFILE env var, or by recording it as the `design_profile` intent answer. Unknown names / bad tokens never error (fail-safe). This replaces the old --like lineage. Run `vob_doctor` to list the resolved profiles. (The keys starting with '_' below are comments and are ignored by the loader.)
name: acme-brand
description: One-line summary of the brand's look + feel.
_look: Resolves INTO target.design + the --vob-* CSS tokens the composer renders from. Every block is OPTIONAL and PARTIAL — omitted tokens gap-fill from the active video-type's design_default. palette keys map to tokens: bg→--vob-bg, surface→--vob-surface, text→--vob-text, text_muted→--vob-text-muted, accent→--vob-accent, accent_2→--vob-accent-2. typography values are font-kit family names (Inter, Anton, Hanken Grotesk, Playfair Display, EB Garamond, Archivo Black, Noto Sans SC, ...). caption_style/motion/grade are freeform treatment notes (e.g. bold-pop / fast-snap / high-contrast). slots optionally pins design-system component names per slot (title/lower_third/grade/motion/backdrop/caption/...).
_editorial_defaults: Stylistic INTENT pre-answers (precedence: explicit human answer > this profile default > derivation/ask). CARVE-OUT: a profile may NEVER default `key_moments` (content-specific) or `target_duration` (content/campaign-specific) — those keys are stripped if present. Friendly names map onto the canonical intent keys: caption_animation→caption_animation_intent, pacing→pacing_intent, transition_lean→transition_intent, speed→speed_intent, layout→layout_intent.

editorial_defaults.music_vo: music bed under voiceover, burned captions
